questions.question: Which Italian manager guided Manchester City to their first Premier League title in the 2011–12 season, dramatically clinching the trophy on the final day?
questions.explanation: Roberto Mancini led Manchester City to their dramatic first Premier League triumph in May 2012, courtesy of Sergio Agüero's famous 94th-minute winner against Queens Park Rangers.

questions.question: True or False: Arsenal's 49-game unbeaten Premier League streak was brought to an end by Manchester United at Old Trafford in October 2004.
questions.explanation: Manchester United defeated Arsenal 2–0 in the famous 'Pizzagate' match at Old Trafford, ending the Invincibles' record 49-match unbeaten league run.
questions.anchorClues: Arsenal 49 unbeaten streak ended / Manchester United 2004

questions.question: What was the final scoreline on the opening day of the 1996–97 season when David Beckham famously scored from his own half for Manchester United against Wimbledon at Selhurst Park?
questions.explanation: Manchester United won 3–0 at Selhurst Park, with David Beckham's iconic 57-yard lob over Neil Sullivan putting the seal on a comfortable away victory.
questions.anchorClues: David Beckham goal vs Wimbledon 1996 / 3–0 scoreline

questions.question: Which stadium served as West Ham United's home ground for 112 years before their move to the London Stadium in 2016?
questions.explanation: The Boleyn Ground (popularly known as Upton Park) served as West Ham United's home from 1904 until their emotional final match against Manchester United in May 2016.
questions.anchorClues: Boleyn Ground / West Ham United home stadium

questions.question: True or False: Newly promoted Ipswich Town finished 5th in the Premier League during the 2000–01 season under George Burley, qualifying directly for the UEFA Cup.
questions.explanation: Ipswich Town surprised the top flight in 2000–01 by finishing 5th with 66 points, missing out on Champions League qualification by just three points.

questions.question: Which German playmaker provided 19 Premier League assists for Arsenal during the 2015–16 season, falling just one assist short of the single-season record?
questions.explanation: Mesut Özil enjoyed a brilliant creative campaign in 2015–16, assisting 19 goals for Arsenal and setting a Premier League record by assisting in seven consecutive matches.

questions.question: Which iconic squad number was worn by French forward Eric Cantona during his transformative five seasons at Manchester United in the 1990s?
questions.explanation: Eric Cantona famously wore the number 7 shirt with his collar turned up, leading Manchester United to four Premier League titles in five seasons.
questions.anchorClues: Eric Cantona squad number 7 / Manchester United

questions.question: Which Spanish striker scored 24 Premier League goals in his debut 2007–08 season for Liverpool, setting a new record for the most goals scored by a foreign player in a debut PL campaign?
questions.explanation: Fernando Torres hit 24 top-flight goals in his first season at Anfield after joining from Atlético Madrid, breaking Ruud van Nistelrooy's debut season goalscoring record.
questions.anchorClues: Fernando Torres 24 goals debut season 2007–08 / Liverpool

questions.question: Which North London club became the first team in Premier League history to go an entire 38-game season without recording a single draw away from home, doing so during the 2018–19 campaign?
questions.explanation: Mauricio Pochettino's Tottenham Hotspur won 11 and lost 8 of their 19 away fixtures in 2018–19, becoming the first side in PL history not to record an away draw all season.

questions.question: Which goalkeeper holds the Premier League record for reaching 100 clean sheets in the fewest matches, taking just 180 appearances to reach the milestone?
questions.explanation: Petr Čech reached 100 Premier League clean sheets in just 180 matches for Chelsea, comfortably beating Pepe Reina (198 games) and Peter Schmeichel (212 games).
questions.anchorClues: Petr Čech 100 clean sheets 180 games record
